steps.hardClue: Activate the Particle Accelerator and destroy the crystal deposits.
steps.clue: Activate the Particle Accelerator and destroy the Aetherium deposits to unlock Pack-a-Punch.

steps.hardClue: Complete the syringe chain and open the hidden lab.
steps.clue: Complete the Syringe chain and use the Fowler Mutant Injection to open the T2 Teleportation Lab.

steps.hardClue: Assemble and activate the robot, complete a trial and escort it into the lab.
steps.clue: Activate Franken-Klaus, complete his S.A.M. Trial and escort him into the Teleportation Lab.

steps.hardClue: Order four files by date and enter their numbers into the terminal.
steps.clue: Order the four Project Janus files by date and enter their code into Franken-Klaus’s terminal.

steps.hardClue: Obtain the Wonder Weapon, deliver the brain and prepare the portal with the severed head.
steps.clue: Obtain the Gorgofex, deliver the Project Janus brain and prepare the portal with the Fungal Head.

steps.hardClue: Capture four floating objects with the Vacuum-Seal Devices.
steps.clue: Capture four floating objects with the Vacuum-Seal Devices.

steps.hardClue: Complete the portal lockdown, enter the portal and interact with the artifact.
steps.clue: Complete the portal lockdown, enter Tower 3 and interact with the Sentinel Artifact.

steps.hardClue: Charge three canisters, then destroy the crystals to reach the rooftop.
steps.clue: Charge the three L.T.G. Canisters and destroy the Aether crystals to reach the rooftop.

steps.hardClue: Defeat either boss, depending on your chosen side.
steps.clue: Defeat S.A.M. or Uber Richtofen, depending on your chosen side.
